name: Little Gods of the Abyss
detailed_description:
• World Overview
    There was the Primeval Gate.
    The Primeval Gate was gifted to the Little Gods.
    Through that Gate, the world was connected, and life began to flow.
    The Gate was the source that opened and closed the world, the key that initiated all cycles of life.

  • One day, an unknown entity corrupted the Primeval Gate.
    Its influence shattered the world’s structure, twisted emotions, and brought life to a halt.
    Fractures spread across the world, and every path was severed.

  • Only one remains: Nia, the Little God with the ability to purify the Gate.
    Nia’s footsteps quietly traverse the broken world,
    becoming the final beacon of hope to restore the balance that was lost.

2025. 3Q

The official version will be released soon

Gamers will think it's a new game. That's how much change there is.

So enjoy the beta version and update it to the official version!!

  • Game Introduction

Little Gods of the Abyss is a 3D platformer/adventure game set in a world corrupted by the influence of the Primeval Gate.

The player takes on the role of Nia, the Little God who can repair the Gate, and embarks on a journey to purify the corrupted Primeval Gate.

Fractures have crept into the world, warping spaces as if life itself has ceased.

Nia must traverse these fragile, distorted environments, confront the root of corruption, and cleanse the Gate.

  • Nia, the Purifying One

Among the Little Gods, Nia is unique for her ability to understand and restore the Gate’s structure.

Nia journey is not mere exploration—it is a sacred ritual to rebuild a shattered world and reclaim its balance.

#

# Main Features

  • Precision Controls and Puzzle Integration
    Jumping, dodging, gliding, attacking, and timing-based mechanisms are intricately paired,
    creating tense gameplay that weaves platforming with environmental puzzles.
    Every action of Nia combines puzzle-solving and performance, guiding players to interpret each space.

  • Stages Shaped by Fractures
    Levels consist of areas with radically different atmospheres and structures.
    Each region visually expresses physical and emotional distortion based on the Gate’s corruption.
    From lifeless ruins to silent forests and geometrically warped sanctuaries, each stage serves not just as a challenge but as a way to understand the world’s inner workings.
    Players naturally experience how profoundly the world has degraded.

  • A Journey Toward the Primeval Gate
    Nia ventures toward the source of existence, purifying corrupted grounds and exploring forgotten realms.
    The precarious stages along the path foreshadow imminent dangers, delivering both emotional tension and immersion.

  • Emotional Narrative Experience
    Through symbolic storytelling and atmospheric direction without dialogue,
    the narrative gently and powerfully resonates with the player’s sensitivity and imagination.
    The story flows quietly yet profoundly through gameplay.

  • Visuals That Combine Abyssal Beauty and Unease
    Fairytale-like visuals and fluid animations converge to deliver an aesthetic that is both beautiful and mysterious.
    Traversing serene yet uncanny and familiar yet distorted worlds allows players to fully experience the emotions embedded in each space.
